title: Stagewise output contracts for hosted endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) + launch checklist
creator: Aisha Romero
description: This PRD defines a stagewise output contract and gated launch checklist for Redwood hosted inference endpoints (generation/chat, completions, embeddings, rerank). The goal is to standardize behavioral guarantees at each rollout stage, provide machine-checkable acceptance gates, and specify fallback behavior across model variants so customers experience predictable quality, latency, and cost during progressive ramp-up.
scope_included: Behavioral contracts (determinism, response schema, max tokens) for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank
Stage definitions: sandbox -> internal canary -> 5% customer slice -> 25% -> full
Traffic-slice gating criteria (quality evals + infra SLOs) and automated rollback policies
Operational runbooks for canary failures and graded fallback (model variant substitution, regional fallback)
Acceptance automation: smoke tests, golden prompt set, perf harness, and telemetry dashboards
scope_excluded: Model training and fine-tuning processes (handled by model onboarding teams)
Dedicated and private deployment permutations beyond hostable-compatible variants
Billing and pricing changes tied to rollout (billing signals documented separately)
Deep UX changes to Console (only dashboard tiles and gating flags included)
requirements: Define per-endpoint minimal behavioral contract: response shape, top-level keys, error surfaces, and seeded randomness bounds
Establish golden prompt suites for each endpoint type with expected pass rates and metric thresholds
Provide deterministic fallback policy: if quality regression > X% OR latency SLO breach > Y for 10m, route to fallback model within 60s
Implement telemetry flags to tag traffic slice and capture cost-per-token, p95/p99 latency, error-rate, and quality-regression delta
Expose per-route rollout controls in Console with ability to pin or abort slice and manual override
nonfunctional_requirements: P95 latency target for canary slice: <= 1200ms for generation under median input length
P99 latency target for production: <= 2500ms for typical workloads
Error rate during staged rollout must remain <= 0.5% for 5% slice, <= 0.2% at 25%
Observability retention: recent 7d raw traces and 90d aggregated metrics for postmortem
Rollout automation must complete a model switch fallback within 60s with no request loss
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox: golden prompt pass-rate >= 95% across generation/completions; embeddings cosine stability within tolerance band
Internal canary: no infra errors > 0.5% over 1hr; p95 latency <= 1200ms; manual signoff from PM + SRE
5% customer slice: Eval-driven quality loss <= 1.5% (weighted) vs baseline; cost delta documented and accepted; no unhandled schema regressions
25% slice: Stability gates sustained for 24h; rollback tested and documented; Console rollout controls enabled
Full: 7-day telemetry demonstrates sustained SLOs and no high-severity incidents during rollout windows
launch_checklist: PRD approved by PM, SRE, Eng, and Design reviewers
Golden prompt suites uploaded and integrated with CI smoke checks
Canary dashboards (latency, errors, quality delta, cost) created and linked
Automated rollback and model-switch playbook validated in staging
Console feature flags and per-route rollout controls toggled and tested
Runbook published with on-call escalation and contact list
Security review completed for model artifacts and KMS usage (if applicable)
Customer communications draft prepared for staged rollout notes and opt-out guidance
rollout_plan: Step 0 - Sandbox: run full golden suite in isolated infra for 48h (no customer traffic)
Step 1 - Internal canary: route internal-team traffic and synthetic load for 4h, require PM+SRE signoff
Step 2 - 5% external: open 5% of eligible traffic with close monitoring for 12h, automatic rollback triggers enabled
Step 3 - 25% external: expand to 25% after 24h stable window, perform chaos injection test (simulated GPU loss) in a single AZ
Step 4 - 100% external: full cutover after 7 days stable with no open P0/P1 incidents
metrics_and_gates: Quality gate: weighted eval score delta vs baseline <= 1.5% for 5% slice, <= 1% for 25% slice
Latent gate: p95 latency must not increase by > 30% vs baseline for canary
Error gate: 5xx rate must remain < 0.5% during canary windows
Cost gate: per-token cost delta must be documented and acknowledged by Finance/PM
Operational gate: rollback window executed in < 60s in a dry-run test
risks: Quality regressions undetected by limited golden set — mitigated by expanding dataset post-canary
Undesired cost increase for customers if quantization profile changes are applied — require Finance signoff
Rollback flapping if model switch is not atomic — require engineering hardening timebox
Regional capacity shortages during 25% expansion — coordinate with capacity planning
notes: This PRD targets hostable-compatible model variants only (no private network variants).
We prioritize human-readable schema stability and clear error codes to minimize consumer integration breakage.
Evaluate additional safety nets: response-length caps, token-level rate limits, and client-side best-effort retries.
